scope: Eight static, single-view, empty-handed character base sprites: six careers plus second Worker and Explorer cosmetics. Not animation atlases or all-direction sprites.

characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent 2D game character idle sprite, square 1024x1024 canvas.
Primary request: create the Worker career for an original cartoon underground multiplayer game called Mine Escape.
Subject: ONE full-body adult expedition worker, compact chunky three-heads-tall proportions, domed yellow hardhat with an unlit round headlamp, orange bib overalls over a charcoal short-sleeved work shirt, broad tan work gloves, chunky charcoal boots. Friendly neutral tiny face with simple eyes. NO tool held, both empty gloved hands relaxed at sides. No weapon, coin, shield or glowing lamp.
Style: original accessible social-game art, bold smooth near-charcoal outline, simple geometric shapes, flat cel shading with just one shadow tone, no texture, no painterly rendering. Clear at 64px. Not an astronaut, no visor, no spaceship, no copied existing game character.
Camera: slightly elevated orthographic three-quarter view facing screen-right and toward viewer, show front and a little of the character's left side. Neutral standing idle pose.
Composition: isolated centered character, same scale suitable for a six-career set; entire silhouette within x=25–75% and y=14–86%, feet on baseline y=86%; leave transparent margin around everything.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no checkerboard painted into image.
Palette: amber #F0BA3C, orange #D97830, charcoal #343743, warm tan skin/gloves.
Text: none. No labels, border, watermark or extra objects.
characters.review: Visually inspected: complete full body, same three-quarter front-right style, empty hands, no secret-role or owned-equipment tells.

characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent static 2D Worker cosmetic variant.
Input image is the edit target: existing Worker idle sprite. Preserve the exact character body size, overall silhouette, foot position, standing pose, camera angle, orange overalls, charcoal shirt/boots, tan gloves, yellow hardhat/unlit lamp, line weight, shading and transparent background.
Change ONLY these cosmetic details: two clearly visible narrow dark-charcoal parallel stripes run front-to-back over the top of the yellow hardhat beside the unlit lamp; a different friendly face preset with slightly softer cheeks and a few freckles; the short visible hair beneath the helmet becomes auburn. No change in apparent role, ability or equipment.
Keep BOTH hands empty, all of hat and boots within frame, same generous transparent margins. No held tool, coin, weapon, shield, text, ground shadow, extra object, new background or Smuggler tell. Make one character, not a comparison sheet. Preserve true alpha transparency.
characters.review: Visually inspected: complete full body, matching original pose/camera/costume, empty hands, visible double career marker, different face/hair preset. No secret-role tell. Static cosmetic variant only.
